suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific metabolic complication. Require documented short-bowel/short-gut syndrome with the relevant malabsorptive phenotype, especially colon-in-continuity/enteric hyperoxaluria when applicable, and separately documented stone disease. Do not generalize to all short-bowel phenotypes. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Short Bowel Syndrome matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Kidney Stones (Nephrolithiasis) with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented short-bowel/short-gut syndrome with the relevant malabsorptive phenotype, especially colon-in-continuity/enteric hyperoxaluria when applicable, and separately documented stone disease. Do not generalize to all short-bowel phenotypes.
